about: Dated events that can move markets: summits, central-bank decisions, OPEC+ meetings and deadlines. Hand-kept: every event carries the page its date was read from, and 'checked' is the day the whole file was last compared with those pages. Times are Riyadh time. Information only: nothing here changes a recommendation or places an order.

events.title: APEC leaders' meeting, Shenzhen
events.why: Trump, Xi and Putin were set to attend; US-China trade, two months before the truce deadline

events.title: Saudi Arabia's 2027 budget: final approval, due before year-end
events.why: Pre-budget statement: spending SAR 1,392 bn, revenue SAR 1,202 bn, deficit about 3.6% of GDP

events.title: OPEC+ ministers meet (42nd ministerial meeting)
events.why: 2027 output quotas are expected to be decided; the seven-country group meets the same day

events.title: US Federal Reserve rate decision, with new projections
events.why: Sets the dollar rate; the riyal is pegged to the dollar, so Saudi rates usually move with it

events.title: US government funding runs out (the stopgap law ends)
events.why: Without a new law a shutdown starts on 12 Dec

events.title: G20 leaders' summit, Miami (Doral)
events.why: Hosted by Trump; Xi is expected to attend, a month before the trade truce ends

events.title: European Central Bank rate decision
events.why: Euro rates and the euro; new staff projections

events.title: Bank of Japan rate decision
events.why: The yen and world bond yields

events.title: US-China trade truce ends unless it is extended again
events.why: Tariff relief, export-control waivers and port-fee suspensions lapse with it

events.title: World Economic Forum, Davos
events.why: Heads of state, central bankers and company chiefs in one place: headlines more than decisions

events.title: Bank of Japan rate decision, with its outlook report
events.why: The yen and world bond yields

events.title: US Federal Reserve rate decision
events.why: Sets the dollar rate; the Fed confirms each 2027 date at the meeting before it

events.title: Bank of England rate decision, with its policy report
